The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: at this moment.

notes: Nu is almost always used to indicate the current moment. In spoken Dutch, it is often placed early in a sentence to emphasize the 'right now' aspect.

senses.definition: At this present moment; in the time that is happening right now.

examples.text: Ik ben nu bezig met mijn werk.
examples.translation: I am busy with my work right now.
examples.emotion: focused and matter-of-fact, stating one's current activity

senses.definition: Used as a connector to signal a new stage or consequence in a narrative.

examples.text: Nu weet ik wat ik moet doen.
examples.translation: Now I know what I have to do.
examples.emotion: decisive and relieved, finally understanding the situation
